per_tensor_fp8_qdq: quantize a PyTorch tensor to FP8 format and return the quantized tensor with its scale
update_parameter_data: update or create a named parameter on a PyTorch module with new tensor data
normalize_static_kv_dtype: convert a dtype string or torch dtype to a normalized torch dtype for static KV cache
is_attention_module: check if a PyTorch module is an attention layer by inspecting its class name and attributes
clean_model_parameters_and_buffers: remove specified parameters and buffers from all modules in a PyTorch model
